claim.purpose: Reserve only the read-only importer sunset surface until its not-before date and no-active-contract proof.

initial.title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2] Gate 10D4: read-only importer sunset
initial.goal: Retire the read-only importer after its short compatibility window and all migration obligations end.
initial.required_outcome: A separately reviewed sunset removes only the importer after 2026-08-12T02:03:02.808013Z and proves no active contract requires it.
authority_boundary: No active contract may name the importer
initial.task_boundary: Remove only the exact importer surface after time, approval, migration, contract, and health gates pass.
acceptance_criteria: Trusted time is at or after the not-before timestamp
Migration evidence is complete and durable
No active contract requires the importer
Exact-revision review and required checks pass
initial.plan_summary: Validate time, approval, migration, active contracts, and v2 health; remove only importer; prove and review.

steps.action: Evaluate time, approval, migration completeness, active contracts, and v2 health
Remove only the exact importer surface while preserving durable evidence
Run exact-revision review and required proof

invariants: No active contract loses a required path
stop_conditions: Current time is early or untrusted

validation_lanes.proof_role: Evaluate trusted current time, exact approval, migration completeness, active contracts, and current v2 health from typed evidence
After a passing typed sunset decision, prove durable migration evidence and green v2 after importer removal

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed with zero importer mutation when any date, approval, migration, contract, or health input is missing or ambiguous.
review_prompts: Verify no active contract still names the importer.
Verify only the importer surface changed.
